# IDMP-O change report 1.7.0 to 1.8.0

Generated by the change_report step of idmp-build. The baseline is v1.7.0, the compared state is v1.8.0.

## Summary

In 1.7.0 and in 1.8.0 count the items of each state. Added, modified and deleted count the changes from 1.7.0 to 1.8.0. The merged IDMP-O modules hold 29324 triples in 1.7.0 and 32015 in 1.8.0.

| Files | in 1.7.0 | in 1.8.0 | added | modified | deleted | meaning |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| IDMP-O modules | 71 | 78 | 14 | 64 | 7 | ontology files with a Pistoia Alliance ontology IRI (excluding external modules). modified means that the triples differ |
| extracted external modules | 0 | 32 | 32 | 0 | 0 | ontology files in a mireot folder, the terms IDMP-O uses from an external ontology. modified means that the triples differ |
| external ontology files | 186 | 87 | 3 | 0 | 102 | every other ontology file, for example a full external module. modified means that the triples differ |

| Content | in 1.7.0 | in 1.8.0 | added | modified | deleted | meaning |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| ontology header | 71 | 78 | 20 | 58 | 13 | owl:Ontology subjects of the IDMP-O modules. Modified means at least one header statement changed, the section Ontology headers lists them by statement kind |
| class | 548 | 548 | 0 | 525 | 0 | typed owl:Class or rdfs:Class |
| object property | 256 | 256 | 0 | 255 | 0 | typed owl:ObjectProperty |
| datatype property | 98 | 98 | 0 | 98 | 0 | typed owl:DatatypeProperty |
| annotation property | 7 | 7 | 0 | 7 | 0 | typed owl:AnnotationProperty |
| individual | 1584 | 1630 | 47 | 64 | 1 | typed owl:NamedIndividual, skos:Concept or an instance of a class |
| all kinds | 2493 | 2539 | 47 | 949 | 1 | subjects in the Pistoia Alliance namespace that the IDMP-O modules describe |
| external subject described in IDMP-O modules | 433 | 404 | 1 | 17 | 30 | subjects outside the Pistoia Alliance namespace that IDMP-O modules make statements about, for example mapping axioms on an external class |
| external term used by IDMP-O | 378 | 375 | 8 | 204 | 11 | typed terms of external or extracted files that IDMP-O modules refer to. Added: referred to only in the new state. Deleted: no longer referred to. Modified: referred to in both states, with a different label, definition, type or declaring file |
